title: Lights, emissive materials and the sky in Rust: light with the built-ins, name what moves
note: A white sun under frame.environment(Environment::sky()), a point or spot light with the range it needs beside every glowing Material::emissive, frame.id(key) on everything that moves, and the look in [render.look]: no custom pass for what the renderer already draws.
intent: The renderer lights, shadows and fogs a scene itself; a game describes it. Set frame.sun to a white colour and let its elevation do the time of day under frame.environment(Environment::sky()) (or Environment::hdri(path) for a .hdr map in assets/, whose sun becomes the frame's), and keep frame.ambient and frame.clear sensible for devices that draw no sky. Light a lantern, a window or a fire with frame.point_light or frame.spot_light and give each the range it needs (a lantern 3 to 4 units, a street lamp 8): emission lights the picture, not other surfaces, so pair every glowing Material::emissive(color, strength) with a light. Strength is in a light's units: above 1 the look's bloom haloes it. Frames are HDR: choose the look's tonemapper (khronos-neutral keeps authored colours, agx-punchy for a low sun or neon) and exposure = "auto" when light and shade sit together, and retune ev_compensation against a capture after adding an environment. Bloom, height fog, ambient occlusion and contact shadows are the look's: state bloom_*, fog_*, ao_* in [render.look] and never rebuild them as custom passes. Under TAA (high and ultra) draw everything that moves on its own under frame.id(key) with a key that stays with it, call frame.camera_cut() on the frame a shot changes and never on every frame. Check a capture as mobile-mid and at low: the lantern must still read, with fewer shadows and effects.
port: The facet that owns the scene's lighting owns frame.sun, frame.environment and the look in genex.toml; a facet that adds a lamp adds its light and its emissive together and tags both.

evidence.note: frame.point_light and frame.spot_light with their range; Material::emissive lights the picture, not other surfaces; Environment::sky and Environment::hdri; the preset caps how many lights and shadowed spots a device draws.
frame.id(key), frame.end_id() and frame.camera_cut() under TAA; the look's bloom, fog and exposure; test as mobile-mid and at low.
